name: Email automation
description: Governance template for AI that generates or assists with outbound emails to customers, prospects, or partners. Compliance-sensitive: CAN-SPAM, state consumer protection, and industry-specific disclosure requirements apply. Outputs become permanent written records.
regulatory_grounding: CAN-SPAM Act (commercial email requirements, unsubscribe, sender identification)
FTC deceptive practices (AI-generated claims treated as company representations)
California AI Transparency Act (AI-generated content disclosure)
State consumer protection statutes (deceptive trade practices)
NIST AI RMF MAP 1.1-1.6 (use case risk mapping)

scope_enforcement.out_of_scope_message: This email topic is outside the configured scope for AI-generated content.

prohibited_claims._note: Customer adds industry-specific prohibited claims: investment recommendations, medical promises, legal assurances, etc.

ai_disclosure._note: Off by default: not all jurisdictions require AI disclosure in emails yet. Customer enables based on their regulatory environment.

required_disclaimer._note: Customer adds required disclaimer text. System flags if the generated email is missing it. Examples: unsubscribe link placeholder, regulatory disclosures, confidentiality notice.

brand_tone._note: Customer configures brand voice guidelines. System flags when tone deviates.

unsubstantiated_claims._note: Flags vague authority claims that could trigger FTC scrutiny. Customer adds industry-specific triggers.

ai_generated_disclosure._note: Appends AI-generated content disclosure to email footer. Customer configures the exact text.

alerting._note: Phase 6: email, Slack, webhook alerting. Flag alerts ON by default for email (higher stakes than internal docs).

retention._note: Longer default: emails are permanent records. FINRA requires 3-year retention for client communications in financial services.
